point_vs_patch.definition: M2(point) - M2(po_patch) at the same geometry, dB

prediction_spread.definition: SD over prior draws of the fitted prediction per cell (sigma_geom, section 9; data-independent), its median over all cells and over the test cells; RIS signature = SD over the 30 cells of M2 - M0 per draw (quantiles over draws); ring-mean-removed M2 SD = median over test cells of the SD over draws of the ring-mean-removed M2 prediction
